lastCompletedStory.title: Regression tests pin the report-first authority order in readWorkerOutcome

nextStoryContext: US-004 adds a dedicated 'US-004: regression - report-first authority order' describe block with 5 tests (R1, R1-absent, R2, R3, R4) to test/supervisor/result.test.ts. These pin: (R1) report.story wins over divergent handoff storyId; (R2) divergent DONE sentinel does not override report and produces no fail-on-mismatch; (R3) DONE report + passes:false -> incomplete, never pass; (R4) DONE report + passes:true -> pass. All 1350 tests pass. Next story is US-005: emit a structured event recording the outcome-source decision and integrity result in the supervisor loop.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-004 only touches test/supervisor/result.test.ts (adds regression describe block). No external library API was exercised.
